registration.statement: Canonical Fold forms act as objects and proof-carrying transitions as arrows. Identity is the empty-One return, composition is forced exactly by equal interfaces, and association follows from canonical complete path flattening. Types are source-bound predicates over generated carriers; products are complete joint pair support and sums retain held alternative labels. Functors preserve interfaces, identity and composition, while naturality is equality of the two complete composite traces.
